source_text: In advocacy circles, the resolution galvanized intactivist organizations such as the National Organization of Circumcision Information Resource Centers (NOCIRC), which promoted it as a humanist appeal endorsed by figures like Francis Crick and Jonas Salk, emphasizing psychological and sexual harms over purported benefits.
